notes: Exam-realism sweep across all 20 problems + opener + teach walks. Factors, Multiples & Primes is a textual number unit: AQA papers set these as pure calculation questions ('Find the HCF of 48 and 84', 'Write 90 as a product of prime factors') and do NOT print a figure with them. A student may choose to draw a factor tree or a prime-factor Venn, but that is working the student produces, not a given figure, so drawing a completed one on the card would give the answer away rather than mirror the exam. No bank problem's text describes a shape, graph, tree, chart or grid. The opener already carries an inline visual (red and blue flashing-light dots via unicode) so its 'two lights' scenario is shown, not merely claimed; no SVG/chart needed. Per SPEC_BOARDS ('textual units, most of number, usually need none'), figures_added = 0 is the correct judgement here. Diagrams shard is identical to the guided shard; no separate PATCH required beyond the guided-conversion PATCH already applied.
